A [[Gender/Legends|male]] served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a '''biologist'''. He worked for the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]] where he was in charge of [[Imperial bioweapons Project I71A]], codenamed "Blackwing virus." After recreating the virus in [[Bio-Lab 177]] aboard the [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Imperial Star Destroyer]] [[Vector (Star Destroyer)|''Vector'']], he continued his scientific studies on biology.

Around [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]], a critical malfunction occurred on the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], causing the Blackwing virus to leak. Although the biologist, along with his [[Scientist/Legends|colleagues]], sealed and quarantined the lab where the virus was, the infection spread out, contaminating all crew on the ''Vector''. The biologist was then forced to transfer his studies and research to [[Bio-Lab 242]]. However, the virus eventually killed everyone aboard.
